history_summary: Record six native species-reference GTDB correspondences for the Community G GenX profile descriptors.
history_details: The exact NCBI-ID routes reproduce six reference populations of 208883, 35, 3, 3, 3 and 5 genomes, with rounded fraction 0.98 for Salmonella enterica and 1.0 for the other five. These describe reference taxa, not newly isolated study stocks, direct assembly placements, measured abundance or exact numerators. Preserve all null stock fields, distinct LM091 and MYb57 reference identities, source species labels and every biological field. Pseudomonas_E, bentonitica_A and indicatrix are native database correspondences rather than formal study-stock renaming. Only six GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. Issues 2591, 2592 and 2604 retain member-degrader, assay-condition and incomplete-roster limitations; soil GenX, liquid screening, GENIA and upstream PFOS/PFOA/community H/E contexts remain separate. The pinned crosswalk's upstream release is unestablished. This scoped correction addresses the mapping discrepancy in 2593 without completing scientific review or corpus QC.
